name: Hamming Radius of Tagged Singletons
details: For the usual asymptotic construction (in particular, with at least two tag coordinates).
proof: The empty set is a Hamming-ball center of radius two because every concept has size at most two.  Conversely, a radius-one center must be empty or a singleton in order to be within one of $\emptyset$.  Among the at least two tag singleton concepts, one is then at distance two from that center.  Thus the minimum enclosing radius is exactly two.
